source.actual_tool_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. The supplied image is the edit target and selected character identity reference. Preserve the exact face, proportions, pose and expression. This output is a single full-body transparent character image, not a contact sheet.

Asset type: static. Placement: pet appearance preview, no baked text.

Primary request: Edit the selected first kitten into a gentle moonlight celestial cultivation appearance. Keep precisely the same feline face, expression, proportions, body pose and signature scarf. A refined mythic spirit-cat candidate, still adorable and elegant.

Identity mode: preserve. Identity: cream-white fine short fur and recognizable feline cheek/chest structure; large glassy gray-brown eyes with readable iris and pupil; preserve face layout; soft triangular ears, blush inner ears, tiny dusty-pink nose and short feline muzzle; small sakura silk scarf and tiny warm-gold four-point star clasp; neat paws and pink pads, naturally tapered curled tail; graceful feline body and welcoming curious expression

Creative branch: cultivation; celestial universe, cultivation, mythology and fantasy are valid when requested.

Allowed changes: coat_color: Preserve cream-white fur with only a subtle warm pearl and pale gold rim sheen, no full-body recoloring.; coat_pattern: Tiny understated gold-lavender cloud wisps along the tail tip only.; aura: A slim floating pearly crescent arc behind the upper body, with a little soft stardust; it does not intersect the head or cover the ears, no giant halo.; accessories: Keep the pink scarf and original four-point gold star. Add a tiny jade-and-pearl charm beside the clasp, proportionate to a kitten; no armor, crowns or human clothing.

Style: refined tactile soft-3D cat art; fine fur, elegant feline poses, satin/pearl/linen props; coherent contact and generous margins.

Palette: cream #FFF5EC, sakura #F6A9C2, mint #BDE2D3; midnight #101321/#171C35 for dark scenes. Approved project tokens take precedence.

Requested framing: 1:1. Themes: transparent. Map these intentions only to provider-supported controls.

Constraints: no text, guessed logo, fake interface, numeric claims, human hands, unintended extra limbs/tails or cropped ears/paws. Preserve readable iris eyes and face identity.

Fantasy anatomy may change only where explicitly listed; keep count, attachment and silhouette deliberate.

Deliver actual alpha if the chosen capability supports it; never draw a checkerboard or opaque backdrop and call it transparent.
source.metadata_note: Tool name, supplied input and actual output are recorded. Provider/model/version/cost were not exposed; null does not mean zero.

visual_review.identity: Face, pose, scarf and star clasp remain recognizable from the selected reference.
visual_review.limits: The generated aura is more prominent than the small-effect brief; simplify for compact avatars before production. No activation or progression event is claimed.
